purpose: CR-37.2 / CR-38.4: reviewed rules for the Lumina Bench discovery feed (scripts/fetch-lumina-ledger.mjs). host_roles decides who a cited result comes from; family_decisions records families already in the registry, on hold, excluded or planned. aggregator_hosts_note: host_roles.aggregator is also the list test/aggregator-provenance.test.mjs uses: no observation in the benchmark store may cite one of these hosts.

host_roles_note: A host role is a first cut, not a verdict: an evaluator host can relay vendor numbers (cybench.github.io links system cards; artificialanalysis.ai/models pages show lab-reported values). Every family that lands in evaluator_result is therefore read by hand and recorded in family_decisions.
